title: 92dv.2: verify DAO Origin Signature (0x12) Schnorr48 at root ingest
description: Child of 92dv, after 92dv.1. rpl_dao_process.c: replace the structural-only 0x12 validation with real verification per spec 05 8.6: transcript = SHA-512('LICHEN-DAO-ORIGIN-v1' || origin IPv6 address (preserved source, 16B) || effective DODAGID (16B) || Origin Sequence (8B BE) || unsigned DAO bytes (from RPLInstanceID to before the 0x12 option)); Schnorr48-verify the 48-byte signature with the pinned pubkey from 92dv.1's lookup; the preserved source IID must equal the pinned identity's bound IID; a DAO MUST NOT create/replace an announce pin. origin_authenticated=true only on verified provenance. Flip the test helper add_origin_signature (rpl_routing/src/main.c:91-97) from dummy 0x5a bytes to real signatures (test keys + sign), keeping a negative case (tampered body).
